last_summary: The best-supported option is C. v3 has positive local evidence of a flattened aquatic invertebrate gripping substrate in fast-moving water, which directly matches an organism using a flat body structure to adapt to its environment. v2 shows a pika lying flat but not a flat body adaptation. v1 lacks positive flat-body evidence and remains only partially observed. v4 shows pandas and birds without relevant flat-body adaptation evidence.
